notes.title: Millie 8 is Leaving Early Access Soon
notes.content:
This update includes achievements and some other features to prepare for release.

Millie Megavolte 8 will be leaving Early Access soon. Here's what to expect:
- The base game will continue to be free.
- There will be a new Millie MegaPass DLC for $5. In addition to in-game content it will include the soundtracks for this and all previous Millie games.
- Without the MegaPass, you will only be able to play as Millie, Lance, Kilzek, and Anne in Journey Modes.

Patch Notes
New Stuff
- Achievements have been added to the game.
- Solo Journey now tracks and displays the highest difficulty you completed on each character.

Account Purse
- Gelder and Mana Crystals earned while playing are added to the account gelder purse. 
- Mana Crystals are worth 1 gelder. 
- Earnings are saved after completing a story.
- Earnings are saved after every stage in Journey Mode.

Wardrobe
- All cosmetics have been locked except for defaults and items related to owning other games. 
- You will need to buy weapons and outfits with gelder to use them again.
- All cosmetics cost 300 gelder.
- If you own the related game for a cosmetic you don't have to pay for it.

Fixes
- Corrected the hitbox for Gem Head's boulders.

notes.title: Monda Rework and Other Things
notes.content:
Monda
- Monda's melee attacks have been replaced with hammer throws.
- Monda can now double jump.
- Monda's stomp does 16 damage, up from 8.
- New outfit: All Business. Includes a daily rotation for her panties like the other girls with skirts.

Heather
- Heather's Black Holes travel slower but last longer.

Hiroshi
- Fixed Hiroshi not exiting his special during his victory animation.
- Hiroshi's initial basic hit does 8, up from 6.

Ollie
- New outfit: Darkside
- New weapon: D.A.M.N. Pistol

Character Select
- The difficulty menu is now centered vertically if it has the extra difficulties.
- Some things were moved around so you can see your character after you select it in Solo Journey.

notes.title: Story Mode Saves
notes.content:
Saves
- Story Mode progress is now saved and can be resumed by going to the Story Select menu.

Difficulty
- Fixed some issues with Grandmaster and Demigod difficulties not having Master+ qualities.

New Outfits
- Anne: Lab Coat.
- Hattie: Maid Uniform.

Other
- Fixed collision on Collapsing Bridges.

notes.title: New modes, new difficulties, other stuff
notes.content:
Game Modes
- Adventure Mode has been replaced with Solo Journey and Team Journey.
- Solo Journey is like Adventure Mode but with one character only.
- Team Journey is the same as what Adventure Mode was.
- The level order is shuffled in the journey modes.

Difficulty
- There are two new meme difficulties for the masochists out there: Grandmaster and Demigod.
- Grandmaster only gets two hearts of health and a single checkpoint before the boss. Enemies are faster than on Master difficulty.
- Demigod only gets a single heart of health and no checkpoints. Enemies are even faster.
- To unlock Grandmaster and Demigod difficulties, you must complete at least one story on Master difficulty.

Millie
- Millie focuses 50% faster while berserk.
- Millie's basic attacks have a little more reach.

Lance
- Lance's hitbox for parrying while focused is centered on him and larger.
- Lance's kicks have more reach and always bounce him.
- Lance can kick again if he hits something.
- To make up for his lack of a dash, Lance runs slightly faster.

Ollie
- Fixed Ollie's landing state when he's dead.

Enemies
- Gorger Gem Gels' touch attack now bypasses attack armor.
- Skeleton Stalker Things now wait before throwing. Enjoy windup, stalker.

notes.title: Story Mode Is Here!
notes.content:
Story Mode is now playable! 
- New Story: Millie and the Mole King.
- The highest difficulty at which you complete a story is saved.

Other notes
- Some rooms in Shimmerpetal Forest have been changed slightly.
- The save database has been updated. As a side effect, your wardrobe selections will be reset.

notes.title: Outfits and Ollie Changes
notes.content:
Millie
- New outfit: Summer Run (Pants and Bikini versions)
Ollie
- New outfit: Metal Ollie. Bonus: this skin lets Ollie breathe water.
- New outfit: Leopard. Donny's back! In Ollie form!
- Fixed Super Ollie's missing sparkles with his basic outfit.
- Ollie can now roll when landing. Press [attack] in the air and hold while landing to roll.
- Ollie can now Stop Drop (but not roll). Do a [down+air] attack to drop straight down.
- Ollie's wall grind animation now only plays if he's not in ball form.
Enemies
- Crows now show up over the foreground.
- Crawler Golems now stay activated for a short time.
Levels
- Added some invisible collision to Sparkleshine Caves to make some walls easier to wall jump on.

notes.title: New Outfits and Other Changes
notes.content:
Millie
- New outfit: Gunslinger.
- New outfit and weapon set: Shade Armor and Shade Blades, based on a design by @shaden1ne.	https://freakyjohnny.newgrounds.com/
Ollie
- Ollie's buffered jump now correctly does a spin jump instead of a normal one.
- Ollie now jumps a little higher.
- Revised Super Ollie music.
- Adjusted the speeds at which Ollie's different run animations play.
- Ollie's special now drains at a rate of 1.5 mana per second, down from 2.
Levels
- Taking the upper exit of a room now leads to the upper entrance of the next room, not the lower one.
- Entering a room after a checkpoint uses the exit taken before the checkpoint so you're still on the same path.
- The map widget now shows your overall progress through the current stage.
- Revised the layout of some rooms.
Fixes
- Kickbridges are now slightly wider so you don't land on the ground when sliding down the right side of it.
- The camera now tracks the target using a static height. Before, it would change with the character's hit box.

notes.title: New Character: Ollie the Cat
notes.content:
New character: Ollie the Cat. With the power of the Donut Steel, Ollie is on a mission to defeat the diabolical Dr. Eggberg.
- Ollie's special ability is powered by Mana Crystals. 50 crystals are required to activate it and it drains 2 crystals per second.
- Ollie's special ability changes the music. You can turn this off in the options menu.

Other notes:
- Characters now exit their special at the end of boss battles and when switching. 
- Special is no longer drained during boss intros.
- The purse (gelder/mana) is now emptied between levels. They will be added to an account balance with a later update.
- Gelder now auto-magnetizes after one second.
- Magnetized particles now travel faster.
- Got rid of that stupid dip in the one checkpoint room in Petal Pass.
- The character's base height compared to the water level now determines if they're underwater or not.

notes.title: Obligatory Next-Day Patch
notes.content:
Patch Notes
-The Buzzqueen's 50% HP routine can now interrupt her energy ball phase.
-The Buzzqueen no longer swoops away as far and it no longer fails if the player is far away when it starts.
-Added sound effects to the Buzzqueen's big energy balls.
-Characters now properly bounce back up if they run off the bottom of the level.
-Heather can no longer spam attacks by animation cancelling.
-Changed some springs to override player velocity so the result is a lot less stupid.
-Reduced the area in which you can trigger Kickbridges so it makes more sense.

notes.title: Petal Pass Patch
notes.content:
New Stage: Petal Pass
It's back from Millie 7! Sort of!

Other Notes

Attacks no longer cause recoil if they kill the enemy. For example, Millie will keep going if she charges into an enemy and kills it.
Max Health Hearts dropped by bosses now magnetize immediately.
Fixed issue with fixed background placement.

notes.title: Patch Notes
notes.content:
- The updraft animation no longer plays if you're dead.
- Heart pickups no longer affect you if you're dead.
- Cannon Moles and Bomber Moles now wait until the player is closer before they attack.
- Turned down the volume on the Grand Burrows music.
- The boss health display now correctly shows Mole King's name when fighting him.

notes.title: New Stage: Grand Burrows
notes.content:
Patch Notes

New Stage: Grand Burrows. Venture into the home of the moles and face the Mole King himself!
Reduced visual clutter in Shimmerpetal Forest.
Characters now have a moral alignment based on their character and current outfit. This isn't used for anything... yet.
Holly has a new outfit.
Millie and Yrra no longer dash if they're dead when moving fast enough.
Mal's evasive jumps last a little longer.
Characters can now be animated by the wind. Some enemies and projectiles now create these effects.
Flailing now lasts a maximum of one second.

notes.title: Fixes and Outfits for Dudes
notes.content:
Patch Notes
- Lance and Kilzek have new outfits.
- Heather can use her Slow Rise ability sooner after cutting a jump short.
- Hattie's blink jump no longer jerks the camera around.
- Corrected some issues with falling platforms.
- Adventure level sequences are now correctly cleared when starting new ones.
- Propeller Moles have had their eyes checked and now fire correctly on Expert difficulty.
- Holly's kicks now properly parry projectiles while her special is active.
- Parrying projectiles now grants one special meter bubble each.

notes.title: Debug Patch
notes.content:
Patch Notes

Debug controls have been moved to the config file.
Holly has a new outfit and weapon.

notes.title: Holly Outfits
notes.content:
Patch Notes

Holly has some new outfits and weapons in her wardrobe.
Holly's hold animation now mixes correctly.
Existing areas now have a larger pool of checkpoint rooms.

notes.title: Holly Patch
notes.content:
New Character: Holly
Holly is a dumb bunny who cosplays as a knight with armor she found and throws a sword she found.

Shimmerpetal Forest
Removed breakable walls from Heavy Mole's boos room.
Floaty Moles now have smaller hitboxes.
Most waterfalls in are in the background now.

Other
Characters now play their boss intro animation even if they enter the area midair.

notes.title: Bug FIxes
notes.content:
Patch Notes

Petalis no longer hurt on touch when dead on Master Mode.
Fixed Heavy Mole's collision issues.
Heavy Mole now jumps higher after digging if he's near an edge of the arena.
Heavy Mole's dig clouds now change from brown to white as a warning.
Added more particle effects to Heavy Mole.
Updated official bindings to include the Evade button.

notes.title: Shimmerpetal Forest Patch
notes.content:
Patch Notes

New Stage: Shimmerpetal Forest
Shimmerpetal Forest is here! Millie's village is under attack so hurry through the forest to save the day.

Shimmerpetal Forest has been added to the stage sequence in both Adventure mode and Free Play mode.

Characters

Mal can breathe water now.
Heather's black holes are now breakers.
Anne, Hattie, Heather, and Millie now have a greater variety of panties in their daily rotations.
All characters now have a special animation that plays during boss intros.
Millie and Yrra now dash if they're running at dash speed.
Millie's down+air now deals 16 damage, up from 8.
Yrra no longer has to deplete her flying time before she slowfalls. Hold the jump button.
Yrra's jump stab hits sooner.
Corrected hitbox of Monda's slam waves.


Enemies

Added functionality for solid enemies.
Added functionality for enemies to require breaker attacks.
Player projectiles can now be destroyed by enemies (namely, the Skeleton Knight Thing).


Other

Corrected placement of some platforms.

notes.title: Heather Patch
notes.content:
Patch Notes

New playable character: Heather

Heather is a polarity mage with two move sets. Use the secondary button to flip her polarity between Plus and Minus to use different abilities.

Bug Fixes

Fixed rotation issues with Mal's charge orbs.
Fixed some animation issues.

notes.title: Mal Patch
notes.content:
Patch Notes

 New playable character: Mal. Mal is an undead archer cyclops with multiple charge levels.
 Another new character, Heather, has been added to the game but isn't playable yet.
 Gem Head's jumps are now more consistent.
 Attacks now cancel the fall pit mercy timer.
 Bat Pudgie's Master difficulty revenge attack is now a skull to make it less confusing.
 Charging attacks now supports multiple levels. Mal is the only character with multiple charge levels.
 Monda's air+down can no longer be spammed.
 Enemy invincibility frames now only protect against the source of the attack, not all attacks. This means that multiple projectiles can all hit an enemy at the same time, like Hattie's chaos globs.


Please report any bugs. Thank you for playing!

notes.title: Next Patch: Mal and Heather
notes.content:
The next patch for Millie Megavolte 8 will include two new characters: Mal and Heather.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44934259/12773698760c5da5c7f66b671dbc991aaa476eb1.png
Left to right: Mal, Heather, Hiroshi, Millie

Mal is an undead cyclops who shoots magic arrows with his bow. He's unique so far in that he has multiple charge levels. Charging longer adds more arrows and power to the attack. Mal also has an evasive directional triple jump that passes through enemies.

In Mal's story (coming eventually, work with me here), he rises from his grave and seeks revenge on those that put him there. The only problem is that he's been dead for hundreds of years.

Heather is a nellish polarity mage. Her secondary ability is to switch her polarity which changes her spells. While her special is active, she uses both polarities at once!

In Heather's story, all nellish journey outside their isolated village of Nell to see the world when they come of age. However, third-hand accounts and even being 120 years old can't prepare one for what's outside the sanctuary.

Look forward to it!

notes.title: Patch Notes
notes.content:
New Stuff
- Rumble is now implemented through Steam Input. Right now it will only rumble when you take damage. Rumble can be disabled in the Options Menu.
Changes
- Hiroshi's neutral charged ground now sends out airrows instead of doing damage directly.
- Hiroshi's rocks now spawn higher so they're less likely to spawn in the ground and immediately break.
- The Options Menu is now accessible from the Pause Menu.
Fixes
- Boss health and other things are properly reset now when you exit the current run.
- The option "Show Gelder On HUD" now applies to the stopwatch too.

notes.title: Hiroshi Update
notes.content:
New Stuff
- Hiroshi is now playable.
- Added an air supply meter when underwater. The meter won't show for characters that can breathe underwater (like Pearl).

Changes
- Pearl now shoots "low" while crouching.

Bug Fixes
- Jump queuing now resets properly.
- Switching characters now forces a hit box update.
